Hi Simon —

Thanks for the interest and for pulling in procurement/security folks. We'd love to run a joint demo (AE + SE) and then a short follow-up deep-dive with your engineers if helpful. To make this work across your teams in the US, UK, and APAC, I sketched a few options below (all converted to local times):

Option 1 — Single 60m session (one meeting for exec + SE + engineers):
- 8:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 16:00 CET / 00:00 SGT (next day) — OK for West Coast + EMEA, late for APAC

Option 2 — Single 60m session (more APAC-friendly rotation):
- 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 CET / 01:00 SGT (next day) — better for EMEA + US; still late for APAC engineers

Option 3 — Split sessions (recommended):
- Overview (AE+SE+execs/procurement/security): 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 16:00 CET — 45m
- Eng deep-dive (SE + customer engineers): 23:00 PT / 02:00 ET / 07:00 CET / 14:00 SGT — 60m (APAC-friendly)

I attached a proposed .ics with tentative slots for the week of Feb 23–27. Please let me know: (A) which option you prefer, (B) names and emails of the engineers who need the deep-dive (so we can include them in invites), and (C) any restrictions from procurement/security on recording or data access.

If none of these work, happy to share a short Doodle/Calendly link — or we can propose two separate days.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0143

Thanks Simon — appreciate the constraints and the NDA. Quick technical note from SE side:
- Our engineering deep-dive usually needs 60–75 minutes to cover integration patterns, network/VPC questions, and a short run of a sample inference workload. 60m should be the minimum.
- The Thu 14:30 SGT slot is fine for our APAC SEs (they're +8 SGT). For our US SE to join, 00:30 PT is pretty late; they'd prefer not to go past 23:30 PT.

Proposed compromise (split sessions, two options):
A) Exec overview: Wed, Feb 25 16:00 CET / 08:00 PT (45m) — confirmed
   Eng deep-dive (APAC-friendly): Thu, Feb 26 14:00 SGT / 07:00 CET / 23:00 PT (60–75m) — we can have our APAC SE and record; we will not share recording until NDA is finalized.
B) If Acme requires the US SE in real time for the deep-dive: Thu, Feb 26 07:00 CET / 23:00 PT (60–75m) — this would be tough for APAC engs (they'd be very late).

We recommend A) and recording the APAC deep-dive for any US participants who can't attend live. Let us know which you prefer and we'll lock invites.

—Marissa
